changes: 1.1.0: window 2021-2026 with foundational work via snowballing; families F6-F8 and R1 added; Crossref added as relevance-capped open source. 1.1.1: IEEE Xplore command-search strings for all families (unfielded terms search All Metadata); search terms unchanged.
title: Engineering semantics for trustworthy industrial AI agents: systematic state-of-the-art review

research_questions.RQ1: What engineering-information capabilities are required for industrial AI agents to ground observations and actions?
research_questions.RQ2: Which industrial standards, information models, semantic technologies and knowledge representations provide these capabilities?
research_questions.RQ3: How do existing industrial AI-agent architectures obtain identity, units, topology, behaviour, constraints, provenance and runtime state?
research_questions.RQ4: Which engineering capabilities remain missing or weakly supported in current industrial-agent research?
research_questions.RQ5: What architectural patterns are emerging for combining probabilistic AI reasoning with deterministic engineering validation?
research_questions.RQ6: What empirical evidence exists that engineering semantics improve grounding, action correctness, transferability, auditability or context efficiency?

time_window_rationale: Instruction-tuned LLMs and tool-using agents; foundational work (RAG, ReAct, Toolformer, SHACL, standards) enters through backward snowballing and the specification stream.

evidence_streams.specifications: Normative documents from IEC, ISO, ISA, VDI/VDE/NAMUR, W3C, ETSI, OPC Foundation, IDTA, ECLASS, GS1, IDSA; scored on what they standardise (specification capability).
evidence_streams.peer_reviewed: Journal, conference and book-chapter literature; eligible for Matrix B and RQ6 evidence.
evidence_streams.preprints: arXiv and posted content; coded separately, labelled non-peer-reviewed, never pooled as equivalent evidence.
evidence_streams.vendor_material: Product documentation and demonstrations; cited only for implementation capability, never as evaluation evidence.

inclusion.I1: Addresses industrial AI or LLM agents, or engineering semantics used by them
inclusion.I2: Concerns industrial semantic interoperability, engineering knowledge graphs or industrial information models with an AI/agent consumer
inclusion.I3: Concerns grounding, tool use, retrieval or runtime action validation in an industrial/engineering context
inclusion.I4: Concerns engineering constraints, provenance or state models used to check AI outputs
inclusion.I5: Survey or review of any of the above (gap analysis only, not Matrix B)

exclusion.E1: No industrial or engineering context (generic, consumer or enterprise chatbots)
exclusion.E2: Generic RAG or KG construction without engineering semantics
exclusion.E3: Not about AI agents, LLMs or their information supply
exclusion.E4: Duplicate or superseded version (conference version of a later journal paper)
exclusion.E5: Insufficient documentation to code (abstract only, editorial, poster without method)
exclusion.E7: Not in English or outside the time window

quality_items.Q1: Architecture and information sources are described sufficiently to code AUF capabilities
quality_items.Q2: Evaluation method is stated (none, simulation, testbed, physical plant)
quality_items.Q3: Data, tasks or artefacts are available or reproducibly described
quality_items.Q4: Baselines or ablations isolate the semantic contribution
quality_items.Q5: Limitations and safety boundaries are discussed

capability_levels.specification: what the standard or language can express by default
capability_levels.implementation: what a cited implementation or deployment profile exposes
capability_levels.runtime: what the agent actually receives or checks at decision time

grounding_category.E: controller-authoritative (validation plus dispatch gate and controller checks)

agent_coding.capability_scale: 0 absent, 1 implicit or prose only, 2 explicit machine-readable, 3 explicit and checked at runtime; code only what the paper demonstrates, 'nr' if not reported
